name: Annotations Documents
description: Generates AI-authored documentation nodes from a target's assembled annotation context, browseable in a documents UI.
project_description: Annotations Documents turns a target's assembled annotation context into prose documentation using the Drupal AI module. Generation sends the target's assembled context markdown to the configured AI chat provider with a shipped system prompt, strips any raw HTML the provider returns, converts the markdown to HTML, and stores the result as an unpublished 'annotations_document' node. A documents browser lists targets and their generated document status. Requires drupal/ai, node, and annotations_context.
